senses.meaning: 机构；企业；营业场所；建立

lessons.title: A Cake Sale with a Clear Purpose
lessons.subtitle: 社区义卖 · 让捐款去向清清楚楚

paragraphs.en: A pastor asks us to bake cakes for a small local charity. Before we agree, we investigate how the money will be used. Each recipient will receive a food box. For the sake of trust, we ask the charity to explain its costs.
paragraphs.zh: 一位牧师（pastor）请我们烤（bake）蛋糕，为一家本地小型慈善机构筹款。答应之前，我们调查（investigate）这笔钱的用途。每位受助人（recipient）将收到一个食品箱。为了（sake）建立信任，我们请机构说明开支。

patterns.expression: how the money will be used
patterns.meaning: 句式：how引导宾语从句，使用陈述语序，表示这笔钱将如何使用。
搭配：for the sake of加名词，表示为了某人、某事或某种目的。

paragraphs.en: One volunteer is sceptical about the plan. A nice owner of a nearby establishment offers free tables, but selling cakes is not her usual trade. We put a rose on each table and display a simple budget. The volunteer reads it and decides to help.
paragraphs.zh: 一位志愿者对计划持怀疑态度（sceptical）。附近一家店铺（establishment）的好心（nice）老板愿意免费提供桌子，但卖蛋糕并不是她通常从事的行业（trade）。我们在每张桌上放一朵玫瑰（rose），并展示一份简单的预算。志愿者读过后，决定帮忙。

patterns.meaning: 搭配：be sceptical about加名词，表示对某事的真实性或可行性持怀疑态度。
句式：decide to do something表示决定做某事，to后接动词原形。

questions.prompt: Why do the volunteers ask how the money will be used?
options: To choose a different cake colour.
To understand the charity before agreeing to help.
questions.explanation: 他们在答应前调查资金用途，是为了了解慈善机构，而不是改变蛋糕颜色或阻止购买食品。

questions.prompt: Who will receive a food box?
options: The person receiving support from the charity.
questions.explanation: recipient在此指接受慈善援助的人，原文明说每位受助者会收到食品箱。

questions.prompt: What does the pastor ask the group to do?
options: Make cakes for a charity sale.
questions.explanation: 牧师请大家烤蛋糕帮助慈善机构筹款。

questions.prompt: What product will the volunteers prepare for the sale?
options: Food boxes bought from a shop.
questions.explanation: bake cakes指用烤箱烤制蛋糕；其他物品不是他们制作出售的食品。

questions.prompt: What does For the sake of trust explain?
options: The purpose of asking for clear costs.
questions.explanation: for the sake of trust交代要求公开开支的目的：建立信任。

contextQuestions.prompt: notice侧重注意到，investigate侧重查明情况。哪句话正确使用investigate表达“追查原因”，而不只是发现异常？
options: I investigated a leak by simply noticing a wet floor and walking away.
We investigated the leak by checking the pipes to find its cause.
I investigated that the floor was wet, but checked nothing.
We investigated the noise by ignoring it completely.
contextQuestions.explanation: investigate是主动调查以查明情况；检查管道追查漏水原因符合。notice只是注意到，发现后离开或完全忽视不算调查。

contextQuestions.prompt: “Mia sends a card to Ben.” 谁是这张卡的recipient？
contextQuestions.explanation: recipient是接收者；Ben收到卡片，Mia是寄出者。

contextQuestions.prompt: “Lena works as a pastor.” 哪项工作最符合pastor这个身份？
contextQuestions.explanation: pastor指牧师，其工作包括带领教会礼拜，不是修车、驾驶飞机或送信。

contextQuestions.prompt: 食谱写着：“Bake the bread.” 应采用哪种做法？
options: Cook it in a frying pan.
Cook it over a direct flame.
contextQuestions.explanation: bake是用烤箱等的干热烘烤，区别于水煮、煎和直接火烤。

contextQuestions.prompt: “For the sake of safety, keep the door clear.” for the sake of safety表达什么目的？
contextQuestions.explanation: for the sake of表示为了某种目的；这里是为了保障安全。

lessons.title: A Sound Archive for the Town
lessons.subtitle: 声音档案 · 保存居民的真实回忆

paragraphs.en: My mother helps build a system for recording local stories. We live near a superb old theatre, but many memories of it may vanish if nobody records them. For three consecutive evenings, a witness to its opening describes what happened there.
paragraphs.zh: 我母亲（mother）帮忙建立一个记录本地故事的系统（system）。我们住（live）在一座极好的（superb）老剧院附近，但如果没人记录，许多相关记忆可能消失（vanish）。连续（consecutive）三个晚上，一位见证人（witness）讲述剧院开幕时的情况。

patterns.meaning: 句式：if引导条件状语从句，表示如果没有人把这些记忆记录下来。
句式：what引导宾语从句，表示描述那里发生的事情，从句保持陈述语序。

paragraphs.en: The recording work is ongoing. We keep a separate layer of background sound below each voice so listeners can hear the words clearly. Some people doubt that an earlier recording can exist, so we search the archive before asking anyone to tell the same story again.
paragraphs.zh: 录音工作仍在进行中（ongoing）。我们把一层（layer）单独的背景音放在每个人声之下，让听众听清话语。有人怀疑更早的录音是否存在（exist），所以我们先查找档案，再请人重新讲述同一个故事。

patterns.expression: so listeners can hear the words clearly
patterns.meaning: 句式：so加主语和can do，交代这样安排带来的结果：听众能够听清话语。
句式：before后可接动名词短语，表示在请任何人做某事之前。

questions.prompt: What might vanish if the stories are not recorded?
questions.explanation: 原文说可能消失的是关于剧院的记忆，不是设备、座椅或城镇。

questions.prompt: How does the narrator describe the old theatre?
questions.explanation: superb表达很高的评价，说明叙述者认为剧院非常好。

questions.prompt: Where is the narrator's home?
questions.explanation: live near表示住在附近，原文明确住在老剧院附近。

questions.prompt: Which statement describes the recording work?
questions.explanation: ongoing指工作仍在持续进行，并没有结束。

questions.prompt: When does the witness describe the opening?
options: On three evenings in a row.
questions.explanation: three consecutive evenings表示连续三个晚上，中间没有间隔其他晚上。

contextQuestions.prompt: “The mist will vanish when the sun comes out.” 哪项最接近vanish的意思？
contextQuestions.explanation: vanish表示消失；雾散去，而不是出现、停留或变浓。

contextQuestions.prompt: 尝过饭菜后，Jo说：“The meal is superb.” Jo怎样评价这顿饭？
contextQuestions.explanation: superb表示极好、出色，评价明显高于一般或勉强能吃。

contextQuestions.prompt: “They live near the station.” live在这里说明什么？
options: They are visiting the area once.
They are passing through the area.
They are working there for one day.
Their home is near the station.
contextQuestions.explanation: live在这里是居住，不是短暂游览、路过或工作一天。

contextQuestions.prompt: “The repairs are ongoing.” 哪个改写准确？
options: The repairs will start next week.
The repairs are still in progress.
contextQuestions.explanation: ongoing表示仍在持续进行，不是尚未开始、已经结束或永久停止。

contextQuestions.prompt: 需要连续三天签到。哪一组日期满足three consecutive days？
contextQuestions.explanation: consecutive表示连续、没有间隔；周一、周二、周三符合要求。

lessons.title: A Print Made from Fallen Leaves
lessons.subtitle: 美术工坊 · 从观察到创作

paragraphs.en: At any age, a youngster can learn to make a leaf print. Our teacher will instruct us to place a leaf beneath paper and rub it gently with a pencil. Her belief is that careful observation matters more than expensive tools. Each creation begins with a real leaf.
paragraphs.zh: 无论年龄（age）大小，一个孩子（youngster）都可以学习制作树叶拓印。老师会指导（instruct）我们把叶子放在纸下面，再用铅笔轻轻摩擦。她的信念（belief）是，认真观察比昂贵工具更重要。每件作品（creation）都从一片真实的叶子开始。

patterns.expression: instruct us to place a leaf
patterns.meaning: 句式：instruct somebody to do something表示指导某人做某事。
句式：matter more than加比较对象，表示比另一事物更重要。

paragraphs.en: We try to reproduce the shape, not every mark on the leaf. At the rear of the room, a child notices that a leaf looks like a tongue. Another pupil uses a carbon pencil to draw an extraordinary pattern. Different results are welcome if we can explain what we observed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们尝试再现（reproduce）叶子的形状，而不是每一道纹路。在房间后部（rear），一个孩子发现一片叶子看起来像舌头（tongue）。另一位学生用碳（carbon）铅笔画出非同寻常的（extraordinary）图案。只要能说明自己的观察结果，不同的作品都受到欢迎。

patterns.meaning: 搭配：look like加名词，表示外观看起来像某人或某物。
句式：if引导条件状语从句，表示在能够解释观察结果的条件下。

questions.prompt: Who can learn the activity according to the opening sentence?
options: Only pupils who already draw perfectly.
Only the oldest person in the room.
questions.explanation: at any age表示任何年龄都可学习，并不限制为成年人或已有绘画能力的人。

questions.prompt: Who is the youngster in this setting?
options: A child or young person learning the activity.
questions.explanation: youngster指孩子或年轻人，此处是参加学习的孩子。

questions.prompt: What does the teacher consider most important?
options: Careful observation rather than expensive tools.
Buying a different pencil for every line.
Making every print exactly the same.
questions.explanation: 老师认为认真观察比昂贵工具重要。

questions.prompt: What will the teacher do?
options: Explain how to place the leaf and rub the paper.
questions.explanation: instruct us to表示指导大家完成具体操作。

questions.prompt: What does Each creation refer to here?
options: Each piece of art made in the activity.
questions.explanation: creation在美术活动中指制作出来的作品。

contextQuestions.prompt: “The form asks for your age.” 应填写哪项信息？
contextQuestions.explanation: age在这里是年龄，不是住址、职业或身高。

contextQuestions.prompt: “A youngster joins the club.” youngster最可能指谁？
contextQuestions.explanation: youngster指孩子或年轻人，不是中老年人，也不是俱乐部这个场所。

contextQuestions.prompt: “It is her belief that practice matters.” 哪个改写最准确？
options: She has no view on practice.
She only asks who is practising.
contextQuestions.explanation: belief是相信的看法；这里表示她认为练习很重要，不等于已经证明这一看法。

contextQuestions.prompt: 新员工需要学习安全操作。哪句话使用instruct表达了实际的指导行为？
options: The worker was instructed, but nobody gave him any directions.
The trainer instructed the worker by hiding every safety rule.
The trainer instructed the worker by refusing to explain the steps.
The trainer instructed the worker in how to stop the machine safely.
contextQuestions.explanation: instruct强调给予指导或操作说明；教新员工安全停机符合，隐瞒规则、拒绝说明或完全没有指导不符合。

contextQuestions.prompt: “This vase is her latest creation.” creation在这里指什么？
contextQuestions.explanation: creation在这里是创作出来的作品，指她做的花瓶，不是商店、工具或买家。

lessons.title: A Bakery Opens Its Books
lessons.subtitle: 街区面包店 · 用透明经营赢得信任

paragraphs.en: A new establishment in our street sells bread. Its owner is nice to customers and loves her trade. She places a rose beside the door, but some neighbours remain sceptical about the low prices. We investigate by visiting the kitchen during an open afternoon.
paragraphs.zh: 我们街上一家新店铺（establishment）出售面包。老板待顾客友好（nice），也热爱自己的行业（trade）。她在门旁放了一朵玫瑰（rose），但有些邻居仍对低价持怀疑态度（sceptical）。我们在开放参观的下午到厨房调查（investigate）。

patterns.meaning: 搭配：be nice to somebody表示对某人友好，to后接所对待的人。
句式：by加动名词，表示通过某种行动实现目的，这里是通过参观了解情况。

paragraphs.en: The owner explains that volunteers bake bread early each morning. A pastor helps organise deliveries, and every recipient is told which ingredients are used. For the sake of safety, the team keeps a written list of food allergies. Low prices do not mean that the team ignores care.
paragraphs.zh: 老板解释说，志愿者每天清晨烤制（bake）面包。一位牧师（pastor）帮助组织配送，每位领取者（recipient）都会被告知所用的配料。为了（sake）安全，团队保留一份书面的食物过敏清单。低价并不意味着团队忽视细心照料。

patterns.expression: is told which ingredients are used
patterns.meaning: 句式：be told加宾语从句，表示被告知某事；从句用陈述语序。
句式：do not mean that加从句，表示某种情况并不意味着另一种情况。

questions.prompt: Why do some neighbours visit the kitchen?
options: They have doubts about the low prices.
They want to remove the rose.
They need to cancel all deliveries.
questions.explanation: 邻居对低价心存怀疑，所以到厨房了解实际情况。

questions.prompt: What does the owner put beside the door?
questions.explanation: rose在此指玫瑰花，老板把它放在门旁。

questions.prompt: What can we infer about the owner's treatment of customers?
options: She refuses to speak to them.
She asks them to bake every loaf.
She hides all ingredients from them.
questions.explanation: be nice to customers表示待顾客友好。

questions.prompt: What does her trade refer to?
options: The business of making and selling bread.
questions.explanation: trade在此指她从事的面包经营行业，不是门边的花或过敏清单。

questions.prompt: Which phrase best describes the new establishment?
options: A business selling bread in the street.
questions.explanation: establishment在这里是营业场所，即街上的面包店。

contextQuestions.prompt: 广告说一种面霜一夜见效，Chen is sceptical。哪种反应最符合sceptical？
options: I doubt it. What evidence is there?
I know for certain that it is false.
I do not understand the words.
contextQuestions.explanation: sceptical表示怀疑、想看证据，区别于完全相信、断定虚假或没听懂。

contextQuestions.prompt: “She put a rose in the vase.” rose在这句话里是什么？
contextQuestions.explanation: a rose在这里是名词，指玫瑰花；不是rise的过去式。

contextQuestions.prompt: 想真诚称赞一个人友善，哪句话使用nice最合适？
options: It was nice of her to insult the new student.
It was nice of her to help the new student.
It was nice of her to steal his phone.
It was nice of her to spread lies about him.
contextQuestions.explanation: nice在这里称赞行为友善；帮助新同学符合，侮辱、偷窃或散布谎言都不符合这种真诚称赞。

contextQuestions.prompt: “She learned the plumbing trade.” trade在这里指什么？
contextQuestions.explanation: trade在这里指水管维修这类有专门技能的职业，不是一次交易或商品价格。

contextQuestions.prompt: “This establishment serves breakfast from seven.” establishment在这里指什么？
options: A business such as a café.
The act of setting something up.
contextQuestions.explanation: establishment在这里是营业场所，例如咖啡馆，不是“建立”这个过程。

lessons.title: The Pond Monitoring Project
lessons.subtitle: 社区池塘 · 连续观察水中变化

paragraphs.en: My mother and I live beside a pond. A superb volunteer team has built a system to record birds there. We visit on five consecutive mornings because one short visit cannot show the whole picture. A witness to an earlier change says that many small birds once nested nearby.
paragraphs.zh: 我母亲（mother）和我住（live）在池塘边。一支出色的（superb）志愿者队伍建立了记录鸟类的系统（system）。我们连续（consecutive）五个早晨到访，因为一次短暂观察无法呈现全貌。一位见证人（witness）说，许多小鸟曾在附近筑巢。

patterns.meaning: 搭配：show the whole picture表示呈现事情的全貌，这里说明一次观察的局限。

patterns.expression: says that many small birds once nested nearby
patterns.meaning: 句式：say后接that引导的宾语从句，表示转述某人所说的情况。

paragraphs.en: The research is ongoing. We measure a thin layer of ice near the bank and leave the middle of the pond alone. We do not assume that birds no longer exist here simply because they vanish from view for a while. The next visit may give us better evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 研究仍在进行中（ongoing）。我们测量岸边一层（layer）薄冰，不去干扰池塘中央。鸟暂时从视野中消失（vanish），我们不会仅凭这一点就认为它们不再存在（exist）于这里。下次观察也许会提供更好的证据。

patterns.meaning: 搭配：vanish from view表示从视野中消失，不等于已经不再存在。
句式：may加动词原形表示可能性，give somebody something表示给某人某物。

questions.prompt: What do the volunteers measure near the bank?
questions.explanation: layer在此指覆盖在水面上的薄冰层。

questions.prompt: Why has the team built a recording system?
options: To keep information about birds at the pond.
questions.explanation: 系统用于记录池塘鸟类信息，而不是驱鸟或停止观察。

questions.prompt: Who visits the pond with the narrator?
questions.explanation: 首句明确是叙述者和母亲住在池塘边，并共同参加观察。

questions.prompt: Why might the earlier witness be useful to the project?
options: The witness can promise that no bird will leave.
The witness can replace all present observations.
The witness can describe a change observed in the past.
questions.explanation: 见证人能提供过去亲眼见到的变化，但不能保证鸟不离开或替代全部当前观察。

questions.prompt: Why does the team avoid saying that birds no longer exist there?
options: Not seeing birds briefly is not enough evidence.
Ice proves that all birds are present.
Every bird can always be seen from the bank.
questions.explanation: 短暂看不见鸟，不足以证明鸟已不存在；文末强调需要更多证据。

contextQuestions.prompt: “Spread a thin layer of paint on the wood.” layer表示什么？
options: A covering of paint on the surface.
contextQuestions.explanation: layer是一层覆盖物；这里指木头表面的一层漆，不是颜色或工具。

contextQuestions.prompt: “We need a better system for booking rooms.” 哪项是在改进这里的system？
options: Set shared rules for requests and confirmations.
Move one desk nearer the door.
contextQuestions.explanation: system在这里是预订流程体系；统一申请和确认规则是在改进体系，装修或挪家具不是。

contextQuestions.prompt: 填入常用亲属称谓：“My father and my ____ are my parents.”
contextQuestions.explanation: mother是母亲，与father（父亲）一起构成这里的parents（父母）。

contextQuestions.prompt: “A witness saw the cyclist fall.” witness在这里的关键特征是什么？
options: The person heard a rumour later.
The person saw the event happen.
contextQuestions.explanation: witness是目击者，亲眼看到事件发生，不一定是肇事者或救治者。

contextQuestions.prompt: “The original map no longer exists.” 哪种情况符合no longer exists？
options: The map is locked in a drawer.
The map has been destroyed and is no longer there.
The map has been moved to another room.
The map is present but not on display.
contextQuestions.explanation: exist表示存在；被毁且不复存在符合句意，藏起、移走或不展出都不等于不存在。

lessons.title: A Model That Makes Pollution Visible
lessons.subtitle: 科学模型 · 用简单材料解释污染

paragraphs.en: A youngster of school age asks how air can carry tiny particles. Our teacher will instruct the group to build a model. Her belief is that a simple creation can help explain an invisible process. We use a clear box so everyone can watch what happens inside.
paragraphs.zh: 一个学龄（age）孩子（youngster）问，空气怎样携带微小颗粒。指导老师将指导（instruct）大家搭建模型。她的信念（belief）是，一件简单的创作（creation）就能帮助解释看不见的过程。我们使用透明盒子，让大家看到内部发生的变化。

patterns.meaning: 句式：so加主语和can do，表示这样的安排让每个人能够观察。
句式：what引导宾语从句，表示内部发生的事情，使用陈述语序。

paragraphs.en: At the rear of the box, we place a card with carbon dust already fixed to it. We never put the dust near our tongue or breathe it in. The model does not reproduce every detail of real air, but its extraordinary black marks help us discuss where particles may travel.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在盒子后部（rear）放一张已经固定好碳（carbon）粉的卡片。我们绝不把粉末放到舌头（tongue）附近，也不吸入它。这个模型并不能再现（reproduce）真实空气的每个细节，但它非同寻常的（extraordinary）黑色印迹帮助我们讨论颗粒可能流向哪里。

patterns.meaning: 搭配：breathe something in表示把某物吸入呼吸道，代词宾语放在动词与in之间。
句式：not加every表示并非每一个都如此，这里指模型不能再现全部细节。

questions.prompt: What limitation does the model have?
options: It cannot show every detail of real air.
It cannot be seen through the box.
It always gives a complete picture of pollution.
It contains every particle found outdoors.
questions.explanation: 原文明说模型不能再现真实空气的全部细节。

questions.prompt: Why is the tongue mentioned in the instructions?
options: To describe the colour of the card.
To explain that dust must be kept away from the mouth.
questions.explanation: 这里的tongue是身体部位，提醒不能让粉末接近口腔。

questions.prompt: Where is the card placed?
options: At the back of the box.
questions.explanation: rear在此指盒子的后部。

questions.prompt: What makes the black marks useful in the lesson?
options: They prove that the model is perfect.
They replace the need for any explanation.
Their striking appearance helps start a discussion about particles.
They show that all air is black.
questions.explanation: 显眼的黑色印迹帮助讨论颗粒运动，并不证明模型完美或所有空气都是黑的。

questions.prompt: What material has been fixed to the card?
questions.explanation: 卡片上固定的是碳粉，其他材料没有用于这个模型。

contextQuestions.prompt: “The printer can reproduce the drawing.” 哪个改写最接近？
options: It can make a copy of the drawing.
contextQuestions.explanation: reproduce在这里指复制、再现图画，不是擦除、藏起或定价。

contextQuestions.prompt: “The soup touched the tip of my tongue.” tongue在这里指什么？
options: A body part inside the mouth.
contextQuestions.explanation: tongue在这里是口中的舌头，不是语言或鞋舌。

contextQuestions.prompt: “Use the rear entrance, not the front one.” rear在这里表示什么？
contextQuestions.explanation: rear表示后部的，与front（前部的）相对。

contextQuestions.prompt: 想称赞一项远超平常水平的能力，哪句话使用extraordinary最合适？
options: Her ordinary ability to remember one digit is extraordinary.
His completely average results are extraordinary because they are average.
Her extraordinary memory lets her recall hundreds of names after one meeting.
This entirely usual ability is extraordinary because nothing about it is unusual.
contextQuestions.explanation: extraordinary在称赞能力时表示非凡、远超平常；见一面记住数百个名字符合，普通或平均水平本身不符合。

contextQuestions.prompt: “Carbon dust left a black mark.” carbon指哪类物质？
contextQuestions.explanation: carbon是化学元素碳，符号C；不指塑料、食盐或玻璃。
